method.value: A commenter described using Cursor Projects by dragging a cloud PR chat from two days earlier into the project chat sidebar, which let the main agent use that prior discussion as live context. They said the agent then acted on that context on its own to close things out, and they also used it for cross-repo work, issue triage, and reconciling multiple items with only brief setup and a couple minutes of input.

outcome.value: They reported it worked well, saying it closed out the PR-context task and handled added complexity, while another commenter said it cleared orphan PRs in minutes. The main drawback mentioned across the thread was cloud-only latency and credit usage.

notes.value: The clearest practical detail was speed on the user side: one commenter said setup took about 30 seconds and only around two minutes of further input.

source_text.body:
Act on cloud PR chat context and close issues
An open-source version of Cursor Projects has a main agent that pulls context from a cloud PR chat, acts on it, and closes out the issue.
·
Sep 21, 2025
Done with
CR
Cursor
What they did
A commenter described using Cursor Projects by dragging a cloud PR chat from two days earlier into the project chat sidebar, which let the main agent use that prior discussion as live context. They said the agent then acted on that context on its own to close things out, and they also used it for cross-repo work, issue triage, and reconciling multiple items with only brief setup and a couple minutes of input.
How it went
They reported it worked well, saying it closed out the PR-context task and handled added complexity, while another commenter said it cleared orphan PRs in minutes. The main drawback mentioned across the thread was cloud-only latency and credit usage.
Worth knowing
The clearest practical detail was speed on the user side: one commenter said setup took about 30 seconds and only around two minutes of further input.
Try it yourself
with
Cursor
Copy prompt
Set up a main agent for my repo [repo name] that reads the context from the chat thread on pull request [PR link or number], works out what follow-up actions are needed, and makes those changes on a branch. When the work is done, summarize what changed and which issue it resolves. Before closing any issue or pushing changes or posting comments, pause and show me exactly what you're about to do so I can approve it.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/cursor/comments/1wdorqg/cursor_projects
